draft_copy.headline: ROOM ABOVE TWO HUNDRED
draft_copy.deck: The scoring ceiling breaks. The standings still wait.
draft_copy.body: Two hundred stayed beyond the board for nine weeks. His Majesty’s Blood now stands at 208.76; The LLC at 203.96. Around those scores, this week gets personal: a birthday celebration becomes a public reckoning, a new father cannot buy a moment’s quiet, and Red Leopards sees an old postseason nightmare returning. The Chili Cheesers brings his pride into a crowded rodeo; D0nkey K0ng brings four planted hooves. At the mountain base, ObiWan Jacoby meets an Imperial assault with two answers still to come. Monday’s four starters remain. If the current leads hold, six teams will finish 6–4.

reversal.title: The Outlaw Keeps the Ring
reversal.copy: The Chili Cheesers let the tail run before the centaur’s pull could take his balance. He cut across the open ring, recovered the loose end and cast beneath the next planted foreleg. D0nkey K0ng checked his advance. The crowd saw the outlaw rise from the mud with control of the rope and one more reason to demand its attention.

unresolved.title: The Encounter Remains Open
unresolved.copy: The rope snapped straight between them and the front rows rose together. The Chili Cheesers dug his heels into the mud. D0nkey K0ng widened his four-hoof base and lowered his shoulders. Every spectator could see the same unfinished question stretched across the ring: who would move first when the next pull came?

tie.title: Neither Side Gives
tie.copy: The last pull brought both contestants to a stop. The Chili Cheesers stood plastered with mud, holding one end of the rope; D0nkey K0ng held the other beyond a furrow of torn ground. The spectators waited for a decisive movement that never came. The ring had provided its spectacle, but neither warrior could claim the final hold.
